I have successfully fixed the bug. 

**Summary of Changes:**
- **Root Cause**: The `median` function in `medians.py` was returning the element at index `len(values) // 2` for all lists regardless of whether the list length was odd or even (which caused even-length lists to return the upper middle element instead of the average of the two middle elements).
- **Fix**: Updated `median` to check if `len(values)` is even. If so, it returns the average of the two middle elements (`values[mid - 1]` and `values[mid]`); otherwise, it returns the middle element (`values[mid]`).
